subject: Priority support add-on & latency SLO for Q4 marketing spike
messages:
From: Simon Kaplan <simon.kaplan@lumenworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:13:00 -04:00
Subject: Renewal + short Q4 spike — latency guarantee?

Hi Marissa (and Aditya),

We're starting renewal planning at LumenWorks and have one sharp ask: we plan a big customer acquisition campaign in early November that will increase inference traffic ~4x for ~6 weeks. Before we sign up for another year, procurement wants a short-term commitment from Redwood that we can scale without p99 regressions and that premium support is available during the campaign.

Specifically:
- A 3-month pilot of premium support starting Oct 15 (covering prep + campaign).
- A temporary capacity uplift (estimated peak 4x baseline, see attached spreadsheet).
- A p99 latency SLO for text-generation endpoints during the uplift window (we'd like p99 <= 350ms if possible).

Can Redwood confirm technical feasibility and high-level commercial terms? I'm looping procurement on this thread.

Thanks,
Simon Kaplan
Head of Platform Engineering
LumenWorks
Simon.Kaplan@lumenworks.com

Attachments: LumenWorks_Q4_traffic_estimates.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Kaplan <simon.kaplan@lumenworks.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + short Q4 spike — latency guarantee?

Simon — thanks for the clear ask and the traffic file. This is the kind of renewal we can support but it will need cross-functional sign-off (engineering + CS + sales). High level:

- We can offer a 3-month premium support pilot covering Oct 15–Jan 15 with dedicated on-call for LumenWorks, prioritized dispatch, and a monthly ops review.
- For capacity we propose a reserved burst pool (committed for the uplift window) sized to the attached estimate; pricing is a one-time uplift fee + bumped monthly commit while reserved.
- On latency: I'll let Aditya confirm feasibility. If we can commit to p99 <= 350ms on your workload shape, we can include that SLO in the pilot addendum with an SLA credit mechanism.

Next steps: Aditya — can you confirm feasibility (p99 350ms) with the estimated traffic and outline any runbook changes? Evelyn, can you propose an onboarding/kickoff plan for the pilot?

I'll prepare a contract delta and DocuSign link once we have technical sign-off.

cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: (contract delta will follow)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Simon Kaplan <simon.kaplan@lumenworks.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + short Q4 spike — latency guarantee?

Simon / team — I reviewed the traffic estimate and ran a quick capacity sketch with our serving runtime. Summary:

- Feasibility: We can meet p99 <= 350ms for your top-level text-generation route during the uplift if LumenWorks takes a dedicated burst pool (reserved GPUs) sized to the attached estimate. Shared pools under heavy multi-tenant contention make hard p99 guarantees risky.
- Constraints: The SLO assumes average request size and prompt lengths match the sheet. If prompt lengths spike (longer contexts) we'll need a higher pool or to throttle long requests.
- Operational requirements:
  - We need a 2-week onramp (Oct 1–Oct 15) to provision, warm KV caches, validate batching configs, and run synthetic traffic tests.
  - During the campaign we require subject-matter contact (LumenWorks SRE) on a dedicated Slack channel and a 24/7 paging window for critical incidents.

I attached a draft SLO addendum (SLA_Draft_LumenWorks_v2.pdf) with measurable metrics (p99, error rate, availability) and the credit formula. If the customer accepts the reserved burst + onramp, I can sign off on the SLO.

-Vivek: please confirm runbook changes below are acceptable (prefill: autoscaling thresholds, cache warmup job, pre-baked kernel selection for the model).

-Aditya
Senior Platform Engineer (Inference)
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Attachments: SLA_Draft_LumenWorks_v2.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Kaplan <simon.kaplan@lumenworks.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + short Q4 spike — latency guarantee?

Simon — quick note on onboarding and support flow from CS side:

- Kickoff: we recommend a technical kickoff week of Oct 4. Deliverables: runbook, alert-to-oncall mapping, escalation matrix, synthetic test report.
- On-call: during the pilot we'll add a dedicated LumenWorks rota to our paging schedule (documented in the runbook).
- Health checks: daily traffic/latency digest and a weekly ops review with your SRE + Redwood engineering.

I'll coordinate a 30-min slot for a kickoff planning call next week — what dates/times look good for your team?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai

From: Simon Kaplan <simon.kaplan@lumenworks.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@lumenworks.com, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + short Q4 spike — latency guarantee?

On Mon, Sep 6, 2026 at 16:22 -0700 aditya_rao@redwood.ai wrote:
> Simon / team — I reviewed the traffic estimate and ran a quick capacity sketch with our serving runtime. Summary:
> 
> - Feasibility: We can meet p99 <= 350ms for your top-level text-generation route during the uplift if LumenWorks takes a dedicated burst pool (reserved GPUs) sized to the attached estimate.
> - Constraints: The SLO assumes average request size and prompt lengths match the sheet. If prompt lengths spike (longer contexts) we'll need a higher pool or to throttle long requests.

Thanks, Aditya — that sounds reasonable. Two items from procurement: 

1) We want p99 <= 300ms, not 350ms. Is there a path to that (even at higher cost)?
2) We need a succinct rollback clause if the pilot causes production instability for our other tenants (we can't accept platform-wide regressions).

If Redwood can propose: (a) a priced option for p99 300ms and (b) a short rollback/mitigation clause for tenant impact, procurement will greenlight the DocuSign.

Simon
Head of Platform Engineering, LumenWorks
procurement@lumenworks.com (cc'd)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Kaplan <simon.kaplan@lumenworks.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + short Q4 spike — latency guarantee?

Simon — appreciated. Internal alignment:

- Pricing path for p99 300ms: engineering confirms it's achievable with a larger dedicated pool and higher CPU/GPU reservation. I'll prepare two options ("Standard pilot: p99 350ms" and "Premium pilot: p99 300ms" with priced deltas).
- Rollback clause: legal is okay with a mitigation clause that switches LumenWorks to a dedicated isolated tenancy for the campaign (we'd pro-rate the burst fee) if cross-tenant regressions occur. We'll draft language and include it in the contract delta.

Next steps: I'll send the contract delta + two priced SLO options by EOD tomorrow and add the DocuSign link. Once you confirm runway (we hear Oct 1 onramp -> Oct 15 go-live), we'll lock provisioning and kickoff dates.

Thanks — excited to get this running.
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Contract_Delta_Premium_AddOn.docx, (DocuSign link to follow)
